statement: Joining nodes' deferred/timed-out membership-publication writes (nodes, node_endpoints, service_endpoints) seed their own row into the local system-table cache with a stamped updated_at/HLC and let the join querying_state phase proceed instead of blocking the full join-admission write-retry budget or throwing; each seeded row is re-driven to a durable quorum-committed write post-join (nodes via the existing 5s heartbeat; node_endpoints via a forced immediate re-upsert; service_endpoints via a new refresh-gated heartbeat re-drive) and supersedes the provisional local seed via LWW. doneWhen: (1) a directed deterministic test injects a retryable DISTRIBUTED_PARTICIPANT_FAILURE on upsertJoinNode/Endpoint and asserts seed+proceed+durable-supersession for all three tables; (2) mgmjf querying_state phase no longer balloons to ~20s per joiner; (3) the rolling-restart gate is SAFE every run (0 corrupt/breach/exit/oracle-blind) with convergence_timeout incidence reduced.
